title: 3 ex-officials appeal to top court over 2019 deportation of N. Koreans
caption:
Three former South Korean officials have appealed their conviction for the 2019 forced repatriation of two North Korean fishermen. The case hinges on whether the speed of the deportation violated the men's human rights.

Source: Koreaherald - 3 ex-officials appeal to top court over 2019 deportation of N. Koreans
